task.title: Импортировать Firefox policies.json через API
task.shortdesc: Create a normalized BPM profile from a canonical Firefox Enterprise policies.json document using JSON or multipart input.

prereq.p: Set $BPM_BASE_URL, choose a supported schema channel such as release-152, and prepare a full Firefox document with a top-level policies object.

context.p: This task covers API-FF-001. Import accepts application/json with FirefoxPoliciesJsonImportRequest or multipart/form-data with a file field. BPM validates the canonical Firefox document, normalizes policies into profile flags, and stores optional opaque compliance metadata on the BPM profile.

step.cmd: Submit a JSON import request when the integrating product already has the document in memory.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/import/firefox/policies.json with Content-Type: application/json and JSON {"name":"api-json-import","description":"Imported by control product","schema_version":"release-152","compliance":{"framework":"cis","layer":"cis_l1"},"document":{"policies":{"DisableTelemetry":true,"BlockAboutConfig":true}}}.

step.cmd: Use multipart import when the source system hands over a file.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/import/firefox/policies.json with multipart/form-data, fields name=api-multipart-import, schema_version=release-152, optional description, optional compliance={"framework":"cis","layer":"cis_l2"} as a JSON string, and file=@policies.json;type=application/json. Runtime also accepts a multipart document field, but the OpenAPI multipart schema currently declares file; use file for new examples.

step.cmd: Read the created BPM profile from the 201 ProfileRead response.

info.p: Response example: 201 ProfileRead with schema_version="release-152", flags.DisableTelemetry=true, flags.BlockAboutConfig=true, stored compliance, id, and revision. Store the returned profile ID instead of inferring identity from the profile name.

step.cmd: Treat import errors as profile creation failures and do not assume partial profile state.

info.p: Error examples: 400 for malformed JSON, wrong document shape, or unsupported schema channel; 409 for duplicate profile name; 415 for unsupported media type; 422 for request or Firefox policy validation errors.

step.cmd: Keep canonical Firefox and normalized BPM shapes separate in integration code.

info.p: The request document.policies is the Firefox deployment boundary. The created profile's flags are BPM's normalized model. Do not send a top-level flags object to this import endpoint.

step.cmd: Record import evidence in the integrating product.

info.note: Import creates a BPM profile but does not deploy Firefox settings, prove runtime enforcement, or provide an idempotency key. Record the source document hash, schema channel, returned profile ID, revision, compliance metadata, and duplicate-name recovery decision externally.

result.p: The Firefox policies.json document is represented as a normalized BPM profile that can be reviewed, validated, exported, and tracked by ID.

postreq.p: Use the export task to render the saved profile back to canonical Firefox JSON before handing it to deployment tooling.
